content: Static poster fallback: capture a single representative frame of the liquid shader (render once at u_time=T0) to a PNG/WebP and ship it as a CSS background-image on the canvas's parent or a sibling div. Show the poster when WebGL is unsupported (getContext returns null), when prefers-reduced-motion is set, or when a runtime capability/heuristic gate (low GPU / save-data / battery) trips. The poster must be theme-colored to match the live shader palette so the transition between layers is invisible. Keep poster filesize small (WebP, <80KB) since it loads on the critical path.
